Common questions

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
Both work. Walk-ins are seen in order, but booking on WhatsApp guarantees your slot — most patients are seen within 10 minutes of their time.
What should I bring to my first visit?
Your Qatar ID and insurance card (if you have one). If you have previous reports or prescriptions, bring photos of them — it helps the doctor a lot.
How fast are lab results?
Most routine tests are ready the same day and sent to you on WhatsApp with the doctor's note. Specialised tests take 2–3 days.
Do you offer home visits?
Yes, for GP consultations within Al Sadd, Bin Mahmoud and Al Rayyan — QAR 250 including the visit. Book the same way, and mention “home visit” in the notes.
